purpose: Test whether pre-reserved genomic and protein measurements explain or extend the Stage A static RNA map without redefining Stage A metrics or selecting favorable variables from observed agreement.
claim_ceiling: orthogonal static multiomic integration only; no causality, dynamics, damping, transition, phase, optimum, treatment-state, or chi claim

matching.stage_a_universe: 9,546 unique-patient primary samples from the frozen Stage A cache
matching.primary_key: TCGA sample root through vial, e.g. TCGA-XX-YYYY-01A
matching.fallback: patient-level match only when the external source contains exactly one eligible primary measurement for that patient

genomic_coordinates.meaning: total number of chromosome arms with arm-level copy-number gains or losses
number of genomic segments with loss of heterozygosity
fraction of the genome containing loss-of-heterozygosity events
number of copy-number segments in the sample copy-number profile
fraction of profiled base pairs lying in segments with absolute log2 copy-number fold-change greater than 0.1 from baseline ploidy

genomic_columns_not_primary.ASprime: present in source but not admitted because a sufficiently explicit primary-source definition was not verified before association testing
genomic_columns_not_primary.n_extrema: present in source but not admitted because a sufficiently explicit primary-source definition was not verified before association testing

genomic_redundancy_rule.primary_analysis: retain all five documented coordinates separately even when correlated
genomic_redundancy_rule.count_transform: no transform for rank diagnostics; OLS residualization uses within-resample centered and scaled values so units do not control leverage
genomic_redundancy_rule.fraction_transform: no transform for primary analysis; values remain on their source-defined fraction scale before within-resample centering and scaling

genomic_primary_decomposition.sampling: deterministic without-replacement subsamples within each eligible cancer-coordinate set
genomic_primary_decomposition.paired_baseline: baseline, actual adjustment, and construction-null adjustment use the identical 30 patients
genomic_primary_decomposition.actual_model: gene expression = intercept + one frozen genomic coordinate + residual
genomic_primary_decomposition.construction_null: within each resample permute the genomic coordinate across the same 30 patients before residualization
genomic_primary_decomposition.primary_effect: actual-adjusted network metric minus permuted-null-adjusted network metric, summarized per cancer and Hallmark module
genomic_primary_decomposition.rank_diagnostic: Spearman rank agreement of the 50 modules between baseline and genomic-adjusted maps

genomic_increment_beyond_b1.scope: secondary prespecified analysis restricted to cancers with at least 30 samples carrying purity, methylation-derived leukocyte fraction, and the genomic coordinate
genomic_increment_beyond_b1.composition_baseline: gene expression residualized on purity plus leukocyte fraction
genomic_increment_beyond_b1.full_model: gene expression residualized on purity plus leukocyte fraction plus one genomic coordinate
genomic_increment_beyond_b1.construction_null: purity and leukocyte values remain fixed while the genomic coordinate alone is permuted across the same 30 patients
genomic_increment_beyond_b1.incremental_effect: full-model network metric minus null-full-model network metric; composition-only map retained as reference
genomic_increment_beyond_b1.purpose: test whether a genomic coordinate contributes static map information beyond the already-audited B1 composition variables

rppa.common_panel_rule: retain source measurement columns with at least 95 percent finite values across all Stage-A-matched primary RPPA samples and nonzero finite variance
rppa.common_panel_note: the admitted 189 features are complete across the 6,887 matched samples; nine incompletely available columns are excluded from the primary panel

protein_only_coordinates.RPPA_PAIRWISE_MEDIAN_ABS: median absolute pairwise Pearson correlation among the fixed 189-feature panel within an n=30 resample
protein_only_coordinates.RPPA_PC1_VARIANCE_FRACTION: first principal-component variance fraction after within-resample feature standardization of the fixed 189-feature panel

rna_protein_bridge.definition: for each Hallmark RNA eigengene, median absolute Pearson correlation across the fixed 189 RPPA features in the same n=30 matched patients
rna_protein_bridge.construction_null: permute RPPA patient rows as a block relative to RNA eigengenes, preserving the RPPA covariance structure while breaking cross-assay sample alignment
rna_protein_bridge.reason: the primary bridge uses the complete panel and does not infer pathway-specific protein membership from antibody names

composition_sensitivity.scope: where at least 30 matched samples also carry purity and leukocyte fraction
composition_sensitivity.method: residualize RNA eigengenes and each RPPA feature on purity plus leukocyte fraction within the same resample before recomputing cross-assay coupling
composition_sensitivity.interpretation: sensitivity analysis only; neither raw nor adjusted coupling is defined as better

methylation.acquisition_gate: no genome-wide methylation download until probe-to-feature reduction and platform-harmonization rules are frozen independently of Stage A/B1/B2 association results
